name: Google Drive
author: Homin Luo
description: Two-way sync a chosen subset of Google Drive into a real on-disk folder, with an optional on-demand browse mount for everything else.

barWidget.description: Pick which Drive folders live on disk, sync them both ways on a timer, and browse the rest on demand.

schema.label: rclone remote name
schema.description: The rclone remote that connects to Google Drive. Do not include the trailing colon.

schema.label: Synced folder
schema.description: Real on-disk folder holding the Drive folders you select.

schema.label: Browse mount folder
schema.description: Read-only on-demand FUSE view of the whole Drive, for reaching what is not synced.
